Container.Name: homepod-temp-logger
Container.Overview: Continuously log temperature and humidity from your HomePod (mini) speakers and browse the history from any browser as an installable PWA. Local-only (LAN), tiny stack (FastAPI + SQLite). The iOS Shortcut POSTs readings to /api/readings; this container stores them in SQLite and serves the dashboard.
Container.Description: HomePod temperature & humidity logger + dashboard (PWA). POST endpoint at /api/readings, dashboard at /.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Listen port inside the container (match the WebUI port)

Config.Name: DB_PATH
Config.Description: SQLite file path inside the container

Config.Name: RETENTION_DAYS
Config.Description: 0 = keep everything; N = prune readings older than N days at startup
